Street-level photos from Panoramax, the: Hotunan matakin titi daga Panoramax, taskar hotunan titi ta jama'a mai 'yanci kuma a buɗe. Buɗe Hotunan titi a kan taswira don ganin inda aka ɗauki hotuna, sannan danna wani wuri don ganin hotunan da aka ɗauka kusa da shi. Hotunan suna ƙarƙashin lasisi a buɗe da ke ba da damar zana taswira daga gare su. Ba a buƙatar maɓalli. Hotunan suna wucewa ta wannan MobSimLab kuma ba a ajiye su ko adana su tare da aikin.
